# Preserve UTF-8 in serialized search conditions

Search and filter condition text can contain non-ASCII values. Use AUTF8String across the IDL boundary and parse the UTF-8 data without lossy conversion, or saved search terms can change when reloaded.

Scope: mail-search.

Paths:

- `mailnews/search/public/nsIMsgFilterList.idl`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/217ecfeb1dc752e78285c5ec11fc0a2cf0b3f388f1f382c1a6d1a9083f803052.json).
